$comment: SpecSelf Starter — Claude Code settings. The SessionStart hook nudges you when a review tier looks overdue, based on the newest dated files in your-life/reviews/. It only prints a reminder; it never writes a review. The date logic is intentionally simple — adapt it to your setup. Remove this block freely if you don't want the nudge.

hooks.command: latest=$(ls your-life/reviews/ 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[0-9]{4}' | sort | tail -1); if [ -z "$latest" ]; then echo 'SpecSelf: no reviews yet — run GETTING-STARTED.md to seed your life OS.'; else echo "SpecSelf: latest review is $latest. If a weekly/monthly/quarterly tier is overdue, consider /weekly or /review."; fi
